videos.title: Donovan's Reef
videos.description: Michael Donovan, Thomas Gilhooley and William Dedham are all ex-Navy pals and have ended up on a South Pacific island after the war. Donovan runs the bar, Gilhooley hangs out there and Dedham is now the island doctor, married to one of the locals. Trouble threatens their paradise when Dedham's estranged daughter Amelia arrives with news that he is heir to the family's shipping company.

videos.title: Babylon 5: The Lost Tales
videos.description: Colonel Elizabeth Lochley calls in a priest, Father Cassidy, to come to Babylon 5 to help a maintenance worker, Simon Burke, who appears to be possessed. The entity possessing Birk wants to be released, and is trying to force Father Cassidy to exorcise him. Colonel Lochley figures out that the entity possessed Birk while he was on a visit to Earth, after which Birk had hitchhiked to Babylon 5.

videos.title: The Twilight Zone
videos.description: A man (Charles Bronson) and a woman (Elizabeth Montgomery) -- the sole survivors of a devastating global war -- meet in the shambles of a city destroyed six years prior.

videos.title: Zulu Dawn
videos.description: Follow-up to the historical epic 'Zulu', which documents the events preceding the battle in the original film and the political situation at the time. Taking the Zulu's defiant stance on tribal customs as a declaration of war, the British commander sends in hundreds of British troops in order to squash the African warriors with superior firepower, leading to the death of 1,500 British soldiers.

videos.title: Zulu
videos.description: A true story of two remaining officers desperately trying to rally their meagre force of 105 men against 4,000 attacking Zulu warriors. Cetshwayo, ruler of the Zulu kingdom, begins his war against the white invaders with the annihilation of the British army at Isandlwana and moves on to his next target - the depleted garrison at Rorke's Drift.

videos.title: The Twilight Zone
videos.description: Bunny gets a premonition that the people of her home town are in danger and rushes to prevent a dreadful accident.

videos.title: The Twilight Zone
videos.description: A hit-and-run motorist is forced to admit his crime - by his car.

videos.title: Mr & Mrs Smith
videos.description: John and Jane Smith are a typical suburban couple first seen undergoing marriage counselling to try and get the spark back in their relationship. What neither of them knows is that the other is a highly skilled assassin until, separately, they get a call for their next job. Accidentally double-booked, they discover the truth about each other's secret existence, and are in danger not just from their bosses, but each other.

videos.title: Money Train
videos.description: A pair of transit policemen decide to raid a New York subway train loaded with money. Foster brothers John and Charlie have held a lifelong fantasy of robbing the network's money train, which collects millions of dollars each night from the city's subway stations. In addition to trying to deceive their boss, the boys must also contend with a beautiful new decoy cop.

videos.title: Lawless
videos.description: Three brothers running a Depression-era bootlegging operation in Franklin County, Virginia, come under threat from a corrupt deputy sheriff, forcing them to fight to defend their livelihood.

A billionaire inventor soon offers Trace a cure: an artificial intelligence implant called STEM that will enhance his body. Now able to walk, Grey finds that he also has superhuman strength and agility, which he uses to seek revenge against the thugs, who destroyed his life.

videos.title: Lionheart

He flees to New York, where he is forced to enter the world of illegal bare-knuckle boxing under the control of 'The Lady'. However, after Lyon goes against her will, she matches him against the champion - will Lyon find the inner strength to take the championship, or will he die like his brother?
